item.title: Psalm 120, Peace in a World of Lies
item.description: In this episode, Dave Jenkins teaches through Psalm 120 and explores truth, distress, conflict, and peace in a world filled with deceit. This message encourages believers to cry out to God, trust His character, and walk as pilgrims in a hostile age.

item.title: Ezra Overview Conclusion, From Ruin to Renewal and God’s Faithful Restoration December 5, 2025
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, we conclude our journey through the book of Ezra. From exile to restoration and from ruin to renewal, this devotional highlights the major themes of Ezra including the sovereignty of God, repentance, holiness, and the centrality of Scripture. Dave Jenkins explores how Ezra ultimately points us to Jesus Christ, our true and greater Restorer.
